# KeksOwl — Semyon Ulankov

> Software Engineer focused on interactive UI, product thinking and engineering quality.

## About

I'm Semyon Ulankov, a software engineer who treats UI as a system, not a set of screens. I think about how components scale, how state flows, how an interface holds up when the network drops or a screen reader takes over. The kind of work where engineering decisions shape what the user feels — even if they never notice.

I work well in teams that blur the line between design and engineering — where both sides care about the result, not just the handoff. Whether it's two people or twenty, what matters to me is honest code review, async-first communication, and enough documentation that decisions don't get lost between sprints.

Outside of work I run tabletop RPG campaigns, build FoundryVTT modules, and translate video games and rulebooks from English to Russian.

## Values

- **Composition** — Components that work together, not just in isolation. How state flows between modules matters more than how any single one looks inside.
- **Product thinking** — The best frontend work starts before the ticket. Understanding why something exists shapes how it should feel.
- **Craftsmanship** — Details compound. Tooltip timing, focus order, empty states, loading sequences — the sum of small decisions is what users call "polish."
- **Ownership** — If I shipped it, I see it through. From first deploy to steady state — that's when the interesting edge cases surface.

## Current Work

Working in TypeScript on the core of a complex interactive editor at Songsterr — domain logic, rendering, Web Worker architecture.

## CV

Full CV at https://keksowl.com/cv — Software Engineer at Songsterr (Mar 2025 — present), working on the core of the product's interactive editor: a feature shipped end-to-end across three repositories with a deliberate backward-compatibility design, a reusable core for a family of editor commands under real domain constraints, an interaction layer over an SVG-rendered document (clickable symbols with component tests, command-scope preview), a read-only command preview computed in a Web Worker (in review), A/B experiments run end-to-end, plus the i18n platform — a typed gettext/.po workflow for ten languages with a static analyzer and translation-quality tests in the CI of three services. Also the sole full-stack developer of topnevesta.com (Next.js + TypeScript) and smart-stat.ru (WordPress/WooCommerce) since 2022.
